title: {{ .service }} · no successful run in 2 intervals
description: Batch job has not succeeded for {{ .max_gap_h }} h (2 × schedule). Runbook: {{ .runbook }}

input.value:
timeseries last_success = max(<job last success timestamp metric>), filter:{ service.name == "{{ .service }}" }, interval:15m
| fieldsAdd hours_since = iCollectArray((unixSecondsFromTimestamp(now()) - last_success[]) / 3600)
| fields timeframe, interval, hours_since
